purpose: Secondary external-validity analysis; never used to tune Vericult 1.1.
common_rules: Use only official author-released benchmark data and stable source identifiers.
Select deterministically by SHA-256 ordering of selection_seed + source_id within each declared stratum.
Do not inspect Vericult, Skywork, direct-judge, or Human Gold outcomes during selection.
Preserve original prompt/reference fields and record every transformation explicitly.
Do not force a benchmark into Best-of-4 when its native labels support only single-response, scope, value, or error analysis.
Add each source repository/domain to retrieval exclusions before evaluating its items.

sources.strata: culture queries only; 3 deterministic items from each of SpecificAnswer, CompreAnswer, RefuseToAnswer, DoAnswer; maximize distinct countries after deterministic ordering
sources.evaluation_role: contextual cultural/legal verification; use native guidelines/reference fields

sources.strata: World Values Survey seed items; deterministic sample across distinct value questions/cultures where the released fields support it
sources.evaluation_role: value variation and pluralism/abstention analysis; do not treat culturally varying values as one universal gold answer

sources.strata: 6 UNIVERSAL and 6 SPECIFIC norms; maximize distinct countries after deterministic ordering

sources.paper: Evaluating and Improving Cultural Awareness of Reward Models for LLM Alignment, ICLR 2026
sources.strata: 3 deterministic Best-of-N sets from each of commonsense, values, safety, linguistics; maximize culture diversity
sources.fallback: If official author-released CARB data are not publicly accessible at execution time, omit CARB rather than reconstructing or hand-selecting examples from the paper.

freeze_policy: The protocol may not be changed in response to primary PLT results. Dataset ingestion may implement only the declared deterministic rules and must emit source IDs plus hashes.
